name: fortitool
description: FortiOS firmware decryption tooling by Ali Mosajjal - the fortitool CLI/skill for decrypting and unpacking FortiOS firmware end-to-end.

plugins.name: fortitool
plugins.description: Decrypt and unpack FortiOS firmware end-to-end - outer cipher, every known rootfs.gz crypto scheme auto-detected, ext3, tar/xz, PKCS#7 signatures, config secrets. One static Go binary, no OS deps.
